# One expression per line from the example designs (JSON strings and {} holes). Backslash is written as \\ and newline as \n; lines that do not parse are skipped.
Party board game
Canvas is A3 landscape at 300 dpi (4961 x 3508 px, 420 x 297 mm, print at 100 %). The ring is 13 x 9 tiles = 40 tiles; change the consts to resize it.
assets/fonts/BebasNeue-Regular.ttf
text
Road Trip Rally
Texts
Race across the map, one roll at a time
list
Everyone puts a pawn on START.
Take turns rolling a die and move clockwise.
Follow the tile you land on.
Safe zones protect you from going back.
First to land on FINISH wins.
Print on A3 landscape at 100 %. Needs two dice and some pawns.

Start
Everyone begins here
Plain
Do what the tile says
Safe zone
Nothing bad can happen
Skip
Miss your next turn
Go back
Move back by the number
Go forward
Move ahead by the number
Shortcut
Jump to the tile number
Dare
Complete it or step back 1
Finish
Land here to win
integer
40 tiles clockwise from the top-left corner. kind: start, finish, plain, safe, skip, back, forward, shortcut, dare. n is the step count (back, forward) or the target tile number (shortcut).
